body: Note that capitalizing the "Script editor" is extremely inconsistent, for some reason.

```suggestion
			- Creating variables prefixed with [annotation @GDScript.@onready], by dropping nodes from the Scene dock into the script editor while holding the [kbd]Ctrl[/kbd].
```

No, that's not right. Either `the [kbd]Ctrl[/kbd] key` or `[kbd]Ctrl[/kbd]` standalone. I chose the latter because it's actually noticeably more common in the class reference. That's possibly because the `[kbd]` tag already implies it, or it's more akin to how some applications describe actions for brevity ("Press <kbd>Space</kbd> to jump!").
